Polyfork environment parts
==========================

The models in this folder are parts of Polyfork's free kits (alpine-and-snow, campground-lake, coast-and-boardwalk, cozy-farm, dragons-lair-dark-dragon, halloween-night, loot-lode-kit, medieval-village-kit, nature-forest-kit, pirate-cove), by Polyfork
(https://polyfork.dev), used under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license
(CC BY 4.0): https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/  Licensing: https://polyfork.dev/licensing
The names below are the parts' own names from their Polyfork pages, as close as a file name allows.

Changes made: none to the files (renamed only). In game they are scaled, sometimes stretched or
tinted, combined into prop scenes by tools/world_props.py and tools/world_skins.py, and scattered as
ground clutter and dungeon decorations (content/environments.json).
